reviews.title: Was great for a while, stopped working later (Updated)
reviews.comment:
For the price, this is a pretty decent NVME drive. The Fanxiang 2tb drive came complete with all of the necessary materials (screw, screwdriver), was quite easy to set up and is working great so far in my desktop PC. Based on my observations during the past month or so, it's running a little bit faster than my previous (WD Blue) NVME and I've noticed that some applications are starting up noticeably quicker too. Overall, a pretty solid purchase.
Update (March 31, 2026)
I had this drive working well for almost 2 years and it suddenly stopped working earlier this month. I was fortunate enough to save all of the important data since it will randomly turn itself on long enough for me to back up the neccessary stuff. Since it had a 3 year warranty, I contacted Fanxiang (by email) and explained the situation. They replied very promptly, offered help and several solutions to which I tried but did not solve any issues. Their customer service center was really helpful and kind enough to offer a full refund for the drive, and that transaction was processed the following day. While I was rather disappointed that the drive failed and stopped working, I was extremely satisfied with their service and would certainly purchase another drive from Fanxiang in the future.

reviews.title: Good job packaging, great for beginners
reviews.comment: Received on time, the product was packaged well. It came with the needed hardware and to my surprise it came with the screw driver needed. I installed in minutes and was able to format and use the drive in no time. I also want to point out the tiny screw that came with it was sealed with a quality sticker so I didnt lose it opening the package, nice work on that. I recently bought an Asus branded and drive they did not do this i searched for an hour.
